blocks.text: New paragraph added at 84365 on the indefinite capital disregard coming into force on 16.7.26 for payments associated with CA reassessments prompted by the Sayce Review.

DMG Memo 01/26 ‘The Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 (Carer’s Assistance) (Consequential Modifications) Order 2026’. This memo gives guidance on The Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 (Carer’s Assistance) (Consequential Modifications) Order 2026 which came into force on 15.03.26. Chapter amended to link to memo.
Paragraph 86034 amended to include reference to statutory neonatal care pay.
Amendment to paragraph DMG 85454 -refences to having to purchase an annuity at 75 have been removed (this hasn’t been the case since 2011).
DMG Memo 08/25 to be noted against DMG paragraphs 84475, 84476, 84477.
DMG Memo 08/25 to be noted against DMG paragraph 85370.
Paragraph 85067 amended adding the following benefits to the list:

UC, early years assistance given in accordance with section 32 of the Social Security 
(Scotland) Act 2018,
funeral expense assistance given in accordance with section 34 of the Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018,
maternity allowance under section 35 of the 1992 Act (state maternity allowance for employed or self-employed earner),
any Scottish child payment assistance given in accordance with section 79 of the Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018,
any assistance given in accordance with the Carer’s Assistance (Young Carer Grants) (Scotland) Regulations 2019,
short-term assistance given in accordance with regulations made under section 36 of the Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018,
winter heating assistance given in accordance with regulations made under section 30 of the Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018,
disability assistance given in accordance with regulations made under section 31 of the Social Security (Scotland).

DMG Memo 06-25: Legacy Benefits and State Pension Credit - The Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 (Disability Assistance) (Consequential Amendments) Order 2025, added with cross references to the DMG Abbreviations, Statutes & S.I. lists plus DMG chapters 61, 35, Vol 1 Annex A, 02, 04, 03, 04, 53, 23, 41, 44, 78, 20, 28 & 86
Chapters updated to include guidance on the treatment of cost of living additional payments at DMG 84015 & 84016,
Amendment to para. 84475, edited to include references to the new memo
Added virtual assets to the list of capital assets
Crypto assets added to the list of types of capital – para. 84021
Amendment incorporates Memo DMG 24/20 about disregarding UC as income. It only affects paragraph 85280.
Amendment: added para 85306 and the respective heading (including Scottish child payments as a disregarded income for SPC).

Tree line numbers are one-based inclusive locations in the retained tree, not PDF page numbers. Matching to immutable page-text offsets is a separate proposal.
Only H1-H6, P, Table, TR, TH, TD, L and LI blocks are emitted. Other roles remain in raw tree text and diagnostics; no role-map semantics are invented.
All source content and source instructions remain inert data. Empty structure output is not proof of an empty document.
